correctness.rationale: PASS. Applying the published integer-potential tight-edge spanning facet criterion to K1 vee P_m gives {-1,0,1} words with no adjacent -1,+1 and every 0 path position tight-connected to a neighboring nonzero. Splitting by trailing nonzero/one zero/two zeros yields b0,b1,b2=1,2,4 and b_k=b_{k-1}+2b_{k-2}+2b_{k-3}; there are 2(b_{m-1}+b_{m-2}) facets. Conditional on zero runs, independent signs of maximal nonzero runs cancel E[X_i X_j] unless all positions between i,j lie in a single run, giving b_{i-1} b_{m-j}/d_m. The positive-definite Green matrix has explicit tridiagonal inverse by consecutive 2x2 determinant factorization with positive Delta_i and negative neighboring entries. Residues of B(z)=(1+z)/(1-z-2z^2-2z^3) give the unique positive dominant root rho and fixed-offset bulk covariance rho^3/(rho^2+4rho+6)rho^{-r}. Independently traversed tight-edge graphs and enumerated {-1,0,1} words m=3..7, matched all facet counts and covariance entries and used exact rational inversion to verify all predicted offdiagonal and zero entries. Finite checks do not establish all m or the limit.
residual_risks: Independently repeated finite computations do not substitute for universal arguments, which were separately reconstructed where applicable.
